en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an old European town square with cobblestone pavement, multi‑story historic buildings with balconies and arcades, and a curved corner building with a distinctive projecting loggia. People are walking in the square and small shop awnings are visible. There is a handwritten signature or note in ink at the top of the image, and a printed caption at the bottom.
